source.title: Bioelectric signaling regulates head and organ size during planarian regeneration.
source.location: Fig. 2A legend and Results text (section "H,K-ATPase inhibition blocks membrane depolarization and pharyngeal scaling")

injury: amputation just anterior and just posterior to the pharynx

intervention.timing: dsRNA injected on days 1-3; worms cut on day 8 or 14
intervention.description: Smed-H,K-ATPase dsRNA injected on days 1-3, pharynx fragments cut on day 8 or 14 and left to regenerate in plain medium.

readout.method: visual scoring of head morphology of regenerates

notes: Percentages only; n given as ">=125" (lower bound, not exact) so n_total null and percentages entered as counts. other = 91.6 "shrunken head" regenerates (proportionally very small head, oversized anteriorly placed pharynx) + 4.2 not accounted for by the paper (100 - 91.6 - 4.2; paper does not say what these were). Head-size outcome could alternatively be scored under planaria_head_shape; single row kept under AP polarity because a headless fraction is reported. Control (Venus-GFP dsRNA) arm has no stated percentage.
